hooks.name: Warn when recovery kit drifts from the platform
hooks.description: After a Lambda handler, provision_*.py, deploy_all_lambdas.py, or amplify/*.ts file is saved, runs check_recovery_kit_drift.py and warns (non-blocking) if the recovery-kit/architecture docs no longer match the live function/domain layout.

action.command:
D=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -f "$D/scripts/check_recovery_kit_drift.py" ] || exit 0; out=$(cd "$D" && python3 scripts/check_recovery_kit_drift.py --gate 2>/dev/null); rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -eq 1 ]; then printf '
RECOVERY-KIT DRIFT: you changed a Lambda/provision/infra file and the recovery docs no longer match the platform.
%s
Refresh docs/migrations/recovery-kit/README.md and architecture.md (and re-run scripts/aws_account_inventory.py if a table/secret count moved).

' "$out" >&2; fi; exit 0
